mapper.insert: insert into cm_profile_photos ( id, profile_id, url, is_primary, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{profileId}, #{url}, #{isPrimary}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, now(), now() ) on conflict (id) do update set url = EXCLUDED.url, is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = now()

insert into cm_profile_localized_fields ( id, profile_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{profileId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, #{value}, #{source}, #{provider}, #{status}, now(), now() ) on conflict (profile_id, field_name, locale) do update set value = EXCLUDED.value, source = EXCLUDED.source, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = now()

insert into cm_profile_localized_fields ( id, profile_id, field_name, locale, value, source, provider, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{profileId}, #{fieldName}, #{locale}, '', #{source}, #{provider}, 'pending', now(), now() ) on conflict (profile_id, field_name, locale) do update set value = case when cm_profile_localized_fields.status in ('pending', 'failed') then EXCLUDED.value else cm_profile_localized_fields.value end, source = case when cm_profile_localized_fields.status in ('pending', 'failed') then EXCLUDED.source else cm_profile_localized_fields.source end, provider = case when cm_profile_localized_fields.status in ('pending', 'failed') then EXCLUDED.provider else cm_profile_localized_fields.provider end, status = case when cm_profile_localized_fields.status in ('pending', 'failed') then EXCLUDED.status else cm_profile_localized_fields.status end, updated_at = case when cm_profile_localized_fields.status in ('pending', 'failed') then now() else cm_profile_localized_fields.updated_at end
